This article compares the incidence of intracranial hemorrhage among prevalent atrial fibrillation patients receiving various forms of anticoagulant treatment. The analysis focuses on how different regimens—specifically [[doac|DOAC]] (listed as NOAC in the source data), [[marevan|marevan]], a combination of both, or neither—correlate with the occurrence of [[intrakraniel-bloedning|Intrakraniel blødning]] [^src1].

When evaluating the leaders and trailers in safety (lowest bleeding rates), patients treated exclusively with [[marevan|marevan]] emerge as the safest group, with a bleeding rate of just 0.46% (39 out of 8,534 total patients in that category) [^src1]. The overall anticoagulant treatment group and the NOAC-specific group show identical figures, with a slightly higher but still low bleeding rate of 0.52% (499 cases out of 96,784 patients) [^src1]. Patients receiving neither NOAC nor [[marevan|marevan]] have a comparable rate of 0.54% (152 cases) [^src1]. 

A notable outlier in the data is the group receiving both NOAC and [[marevan|marevan]] simultaneously [^src1]. This combination therapy results in a markedly higher bleeding rate of 1.41% (21 out of 1,488 patients), which is nearly three times the rate observed in the monotherapy or no-therapy groups [^src1]. Because the evidence is drawn from a single dated section, it is not possible to identify longitudinal trends or changes in these bleeding rates over time [^src1].

## Table: AFDK_2023.pdf, p. 98

Rows compare: behandlingstype · Columns show: antal-og-procent

| Behandling | Antal uden blødning | % uden blødning | Antal med blødning | % med blødning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| AK-behandling | 96285 | 99.48 | 499 | 0.52 |
| NOAC | 96285 | 99.48 | 499 | 0.52 |
| Marevan | 8495 | 99.54 | 39 | 0.46 |
| Både NOAC og Marevan | 1467 | 98.59 | 21 | 1.41 |
| Hverken NOAC eller Marevan | 27852 | 99.46 | 152 | 0.54 |

Entities: doac, marevan, intrakraniel-bloedning

Summary: Tabellen viser, at intrakraniel blødning forekommer både hos patienter på NOAC, Marevan og uden antikoagulantbehandling, men med lavest andel blandt Marevan-brugere (0,46 %) og højest blandt dem, der modtager både NOAC og Marevan (1,41 %).
